scripts.dev:backend: concurrently -n auth,request,command,query,engine "npm run dev:auth-api" "npm run dev:request-api" "npm run dev:command-api" "npm run dev:query-api" "npm run dev:engine"
scripts.dev:frontend: concurrently -n web-landing,web-client,web-supplier,web-admin "npm run dev:web-landing" "npm run dev:web-client" "npm run dev:web-supplier" "npm run dev:web-admin"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n auth,request,command,query,engine,ocr,web-client,web-supplier,web-admin "npm run dev:auth-api" "npm run dev:request-api" "npm run dev:command-api" "npm run dev:query-api" "npm run dev:engine" "npm run dev:ocr" "npm run dev:web-client" "npm run dev:web-supplier" "npm run dev:web-admin"
scripts.build: npm run build:frontends && npm run build:services
scripts.ci:audit: npm run test:hash-chain && npm run test:audit-report && npm run verify:hash-chain:all
scripts.build:frontends: npm --prefix apps/web-landing run build && npm --prefix apps/web-client run build && npm --prefix apps/web-supplier run build && npm --prefix apps/web-admin run build
scripts.build:services: npm --prefix services/auth-api run build && tsc -p services/request-api/tsconfig.json && tsc -p services/command-api/tsconfig.json && tsc -p services/query-api/tsconfig.json && npm run build:ocr
